description: This file implements a service switcher system for runtime switching between multiple services, including strategy classes, a main pipeline class, and internal filtering mechanisms.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcherStrategy
classes.description: Base class for defining different service switching strategies.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcherStrategyManual
classes.description: Manual strategy allowing user to select active service.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcher
classes.description: Main class implementing a runtime service switching pipeline with internal filtering.

classes.name: ServiceSwitcher.ServiceSwitcherFilterFrame
classes.description: Internal control frame used for filtering frames based on active service.

methods.name: ServiceSwitcherStrategy.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with a list of services.

methods.name: ServiceSwitcherStrategy.handle_frame
methods.description: Abstract method to handle a frame controlling service switching.

methods.name: ServiceSwitcherStrategyManual.__init__
methods.description: Initializes manual switching strategy, sets first service as active.

methods.name: ServiceSwitcherStrategyManual.handle_frame
methods.description: Handles frames to switch active service if frame is a manual switch frame.

methods.name: ServiceSwitcherStrategyManual._set_active_if_available
methods.description: Sets the active service if it is in the list of available services.

methods.name: ServiceSwitcher.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the service switcher with services and a switching strategy.

methods.name: ServiceSwitcher._make_pipeline_definitions
methods.description: Creates pipeline definitions for each service.

methods.name: ServiceSwitcher._make_pipeline_definition
methods.description: Creates a pipeline definition for a single service.

methods.name: ServiceSwitcher.process_frame
methods.description: Processes frames, handling frames that affect service switching.
